items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: "he'd always say to me, 'Well, Madam Queen, what do you think about me doing so-and-so?'"

ctx.x: in Harlem. I was trying to bring white patrons back to Harlem. A lot of them did come up while I was there. So I went back into his place until the same night, day, that the President was assassinated. I couldn't take it; I just came on out. I decided I wanted to go into business. He was talking to me about going into business. In the meantime he married a girl, the most beautiful girl I've ever seen in my life. She may have been a little upset because Mr. Wells was close to me and he'd always say to me, "Well,…
So this was what, about 1963 or '4 that you went to California with Peter?
